title: A generic construction of free algebras in varieties of Hilbert algebras and Brouwerian semilattices
summary: We give a generic construction of the n-generated free Hilbert algebras and Brouwerian semilattices by a uniform method applicable to any variety of Hilbert algebras or Brouwerian semilattices, as long as a manageable description of subdirectly irreducible algebras in that variety is available. A slight modification yields analogous constructions for varieties of Hilbert algebras and Brouwerian semilattices with zero. As examples we construct free algebras in varieties of bounded height and of bounded width; we also find a closed formula for the free spectrum of linear Hilbert algebras.…
